$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # ladder-a
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    what ran, in order:
        parse ran on x
        resolve ran on x
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on x
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/evaluate
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/parse
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/resolve
PASS
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./b  # ladder-b

$ cat testdata/script/x.txtar
The root package, ., owns parse, resolve and evaluate, and ./b uses parse for outline.
-- in/evaluate/out/values.txt --
evaluate 1
-- in/outline/out/values.txt --
outline 1
-- out/evaluate/outcome --
accepted
-- out/evaluate/values.txt --
evaluate 1
-- out/outline/outcome --
accepted
-- out/outline/values.txt --
outline 1
-- out/parse/outcome --
accepted
-- out/resolve/outcome --
accepted

$ edit testdata/script/bad.txtar  # a case parse wrongly rejects
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./b  # ladder-b
    script/bad: outline is blocked: the lift parse failed on the case, and testdata/script/bad.txtar, out/parse/error.txt, records its error.
    what ran, in order:

        parse ran on x
        outline's probe ran
        outline ran on x

        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/outline
PASS

$ go test  # ladder-a
    script/bad: parse rejects the script, and nothing says it should.
        evaluate: Does what the case's evaluate/ tree says, from the stage it consumes.
        out/evaluate/outcome has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
    script/bad: parse rejects the script, and nothing says it should.
        parse: Parses the script, as its parse/ tree says.
        parse returned an error, but the case states no property parse rejects:
          A1: not a number
        Fix the code, or state the property on the case and in parse's Rejects.
        out/parse/error.txt has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
        out/parse/outcome has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
        out/parse/stderr.txt has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
    script/bad: parse rejects the script, and nothing says it should.
        resolve: Resolves the parsed script, as its resolve/ tree says.
        out/resolve/outcome has no golden.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it, and read it before committing.
    what ran, in order:
        parse ran on bad
        parse ran on x
        resolve ran on x
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on x
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/bad
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/bad/evaluate
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/bad/parse
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/bad/resolve
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/evaluate
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/parse
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/x/resolve
FAIL
[exit 1]
